activeStrategy.summary: Same scan-and-correct flow as v1, but posts the missing-VAT correction directly to account 2710 instead of account 6500 with vatType, avoiding Tripletex auto-VAT splitting.
activeStrategy.hypothesis: v1 posts to 6500 with forceVatTypeId, causing Tripletex to auto-split the gross into net+VAT (920 to 2710 instead of 4587.50). Posting directly to 2710 without vatType avoids the split and puts the full VAT amount where the scorer expects it.
